path.style: fill: var(--fig-ok); opacity: 0.1; stroke: var(--fig-ok); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linejoin: miter
fill: var(--fig-navy); opacity: 0.1; stroke: var(--fig-navy); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linejoin: miter
fill: var(--fig-accent); opacity: 0.1; stroke: var(--fig-accent); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linejoin: miter

fill: var(--fig-muted); font: italic 7.8px 'IBM Plex Mono', 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace; text-anchor: start
